summary: Iteration 6 tested the Chat Folders feature end to end. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass. It covers folder CRUD, whitespace normalization, 1-60 character limits, case-insensitive duplicates returning 409, names with regex special characters, per-user isolation (404 on another user's folder/chat; same folder name allowed for different users), PUT /chats/{id}/folder (move, unfile, unknown folder or chat returns 404), DELETE folder unfiling both active and archived chats (moved_chats=2), and pinning keeping folder_id. Frontend: all requested flows pass in Playwright, including native HTML5 drag-and-drop (page.drag_and_drop works). Covered: creating a folder with Enter, empty name cancels, duplicate name shows a toast; dragging a chat into a folder updates the count and persists after reload; dropping onto a collapsed folder works; dragging back to unfiled-drop-zone works; Move to folder and Remove from folder in the chat menu work; collapse state persists across reload; renaming normalizes whitespace and a duplicate rename shows a toast and keeps the old name; deleting a folder (confirm) returns its chats to the date groups and persists; a pinned chat shows only in Pinned and returns to its folder when unpinned; search hides folders without matches; regression of rename/pin/export/archive/delete via the menu and the Ctrl+K palette. One UI bug was found and fixed: the chat ellipsis menu always opened at the top-left of the viewport (x=0,y=8) instead of under the row.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: the menu was positioned from el.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect(). In the preview, the parent is a `display: contents` wrapper span with a 0x0 rect, so the menu always rendered at top:8px/left:0 and covered the sidebar header. Now walks up past display:contents ancestors; verified the menu opens at row.bottom+4.

action_items: Optional: collapsedFolders useState initializer reads localStorage only once with user?.id. If a different user logs in without Sidebar remounting, they would see the previous key's state. Consider re-reading it in a useEffect on user.id.
Optional: dropping a chat onto the zone it is already in (e.g. an unfiled chat onto unfiled-drop-zone) still makes a PUT call. Skip it when the folder_id is unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend folder endpoints are clean: Pydantic validation, re.escape in the duplicate regex, user_id scoping on every query, _id excluded.

rename_folder runs the duplicate check before checking existence, so renaming another user's folder to a name the caller already has returns 409 instead of 404. Harmless (no data leak), but the order could be swapped.
Folder delete runs update_many across archived chats too (good). Chat delete has no folder impact (fine).
